title: ICMA CMA® & APA (Institute of Certified Management Accountants)
source: ICMA Post-Graduate CMA Program Syllabus & Regulations
summary: The premier Commonwealth and international post-graduate management accounting credential bridging Strategic Cost Management (SCM) and Strategic Financial Analysis (SFA), conferring the CMA and APA designations.

standard.name: Standard Post-Graduate Track
standard.blurb: Complete the foundational tiers (APA) or post-graduate entry, master SCM and SFA, pass comprehensive examinations, and verify 3 to 5 years senior experience.

stages.title: Stage 1: Foundation & Accredited Professional Accountant (APA) Tier
stages.subtitle: Financial accounting, management systems, and intermediate accounting

nodes.name: Financial Accounting and Reporting
nodes.description: Comprehensive financial accounting principles, accruals, ledger mechanics, corporate financial statements under IFRS, and cash flow analysis.

nodes.name: Management Accounting Systems
nodes.description: Cost behavior, cost-volume-profit (CVP) analysis, absorption and variable costing, budgeting processes, and standard costing variances.

nodes.name: Accredited Professional Accountant (APA) Award
nodes.description: Intermediate membership tier: conferral of the Accredited Professional Accountant (APA) designation upon completing foundational subjects.

stages.title: Stage 2: Post-Graduate CMA Core Program
stages.subtitle: Strategic Cost Management (SCM) & Strategic Financial Analysis (SFA)

nodes.name: Strategic Cost Management (SCM)
nodes.description: Value chain analysis, activity-based management, target costing, life-cycle costing, Kaizen, environmental management accounting, and Theory of Constraints (TOC).
topics: Value Chain Management & Strategic Cost Driver Analysis
Target Costing, Kaizen Costing & Life-Cycle Costing
Strategic Pricing Decisions & Customer Profitability Analysis

nodes.name: Strategic Financial Analysis (SFA)
nodes.format: Comprehensive Strategic Financial Case Study & Modeling
nodes.description: Financial statement analysis, distress prediction models (Altman Z-Score), corporate valuation models (DCF, Economic Value Added), M&A due diligence, and capital restructuring.
topics: Advanced Financial Statement Analysis & Quality of Earnings Evaluation
Financial Distress Prediction Models (Altman Z-Score, Beneish M-Score)
Business Valuation: Discounted Cash Flows (DCF) & Economic Value Added (EVA)
Risk Management & Strategic Capital Financing Decisions

stages.title: Stage 3: Professional Experience & CMA Fellow Admission
stages.subtitle: 3 to 5 Years Senior Management Accounting Experience

nodes.name: 3 to 5 Years Senior Management Accounting Experience
nodes.description: Demonstrate 3 to 5 years of senior professional experience in management accounting, corporate finance, financial planning, or general business management.

nodes.name: Certified Management Accountant (CMA) Conferred
nodes.description: Formal admission to full Certified Management Accountant (CMA Australia/UK) membership and entitlement to use the post-nominal initials CMA.
topics: Adherence to ICMA Code of Ethics
